threaten.translationZh: 私下讨论这个问题会让位高权重者感觉威胁较小。
threaten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

threaten.sentenceEn: Even as we humans count on forests to soak up a good share of the carbon dioxide we produce, we are threatening their ability to do so.
threaten.translationZh: 尽管人类指望森林吸收我们产生的大量二氧化碳，但我们却在威胁着森林的这种能力。
threaten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

threaten.sentenceEn: Finally, because automation threatens to widen the gap between capital income and labor income, taxes and the safety net will have to be rethought.
threaten.translationZh: 最后，由于自动化可能会扩大资本收入与劳动收入之间的差距，我们必须重新思考税收和社会保障体系。
threaten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

threaten.sentenceEn: These new forms were at first mainly written by scholars and performed by amateurs, but in England, as everywhere else in western Europe, the growth of a class of professional actors was threatening to make the drama popular, whether it should be new or old, classical or medieval, literary or farcical.
threaten.translationZh: 这些新形式最初主要由学者创作，由业余爱好者表演，但在英国，如同西欧其他各地一样，职业演员阶层的兴起正推动戏剧走向大众化，无论其是新是旧、古典还是中世纪、文学性还是滑稽性。
threaten.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

threaten.sentenceEn: Who will be most threatened by automation?
threaten.translationZh: 谁将受到自动化的最大威胁？

track.sentenceEn: A mixed system means that high-speed trains must travel on the regular tracks on certain routes or when passing through large cities.
track.translationZh: 混合系统意味着高铁在特定路线或穿过大城市时，必须在普速轨道上行驶。
track.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

track.sentenceEn: How can we inform decision makers about the best ways to bring down carbon emissions if we can't track the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere, where it's coming from and who's producing it?
track.translationZh: 如果我们无法追踪大气中的二氧化碳含量、其来源以及排放者，又怎能告知决策者降低碳排放的最佳方法呢？
track.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

track.sentenceEn: A Reddit webpage devoted to the phenomenon, boasting nearly 50,000 members, showcases images of local desire paths adorned with signs instructing pedestrians to adhere to designated walkways, underscoring the rebellious nature inherent in these human-made tracks .
track.translationZh: Reddit上有一个专门讨论这一现象的网页，拥有近5万名成员。该网页展示了各种本地“欲望小径”的图片，这些小径旁往往立着指示行人走指定步道的标牌，凸显了这些人为路径中固有的叛逆性质。
track.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

track.sentenceEn: Often appearing as trodden dirt tracks through otherwise neat green spaces, these routes of collective disobedience cut corners, bisect lawns and cross hills, representing the natural capability of people (and animals) to go from point A to point B most effectively.
track.translationZh: 这些由集体“违规”踏出的路径，常常在整齐的绿地中形成一条条被踩出的泥土小径，它们抄近道、横穿草坪、翻越山丘，展现了人类（和动物）以最有效方式从A点到达B点的本能倾向。
track.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

track.sentenceEn: According to the website Lexica, which tracks over 10 million Stable Diffusion images and prompts, Rutkowski's name has been used as a prompt around 93,000 times.
track.translationZh: 据追踪超过1000万张Stable Diffusion图像和提示词的网站Lexica统计，鲁特科夫斯基的名字已被用作提示词约93,000次。
track.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

track.sentenceEn: It would be absurd to try to track the changing price of sports cars since 1695, but to ask the same question of nails makes perfect sense.
track.translationZh: 试图追踪1695年以来跑车价格的变化会显得荒谬可笑，但对钉子提出同样的问题却完全合情合理。
track.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

thus.sentenceEn: Dean Gallea: Zoos save people trips to wilderness areas and thus contribute to wildlife conservation.
thus.translationZh: 迪恩·加利亚：动物园使人们无需前往荒野地区，从而为野生动物保护做出贡献。
thus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

thus.sentenceEn: In addition, new digital technologies have allowed more rapid trading of equities, quicker use of information, and thus shorter attention spans in financial markets.
thus.translationZh: 此外，新的数字技术使得股票交易更加迅速，信息利用更加快捷，从而导致金融市场中的关注周期变得更短。
thus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

thus.sentenceEn: The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care, thus addressing a long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions.
thus.translationZh: 后一项措施将在很大程度上抵消每年预先资助退休人员医疗保健的财务负担，从而解决美国邮政署及其工会长期以来的一项抱怨。
thus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

thus.sentenceEn: The commission ignores that for several decades America's colleges and universities have produced graduates who don't know the content and character of liberal education and are thus deprived of its benefits.
thus.translationZh: 该委员会忽视了这样一个事实：几十年来，美国的高等院校培养出的毕业生并不了解人文教育的内涵和特点，因此也无法从中受益。
thus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

thus.sentenceEn: On the overturned provisions the majority held Congress had deliberately "occupied the field" and Arizona had thus intruded on the federal's privileged powers.
thus.translationZh: 对于被推翻的条款，多数法官认为国会已刻意'占据该领域'，因此亚利桑那州侵犯了联邦的特权。
thus.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

thus.sentenceEn: Zoos save people trips to wilderness areas and thus contribute to wildlife conservation.
thus.translationZh: 动物园让人们无需前往荒野地区，从而为野生动物保护做出贡献。

technological.sentenceEn: Between two great wars this technological innovation built a new kind of national consciousness.
technological.translationZh: 在两次大战期间，这项技术创新构建了一种全新的民族意识。
technological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

technological.sentenceEn: The carbon emissions from technological research are well spent: ultimately this research will safeguard the future of our planet.
technological.translationZh: 技术研究产生的碳排放是值得的：这项研究最终将守护我们星球的未来。
technological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

technological.sentenceEn: But Judge Patricia Millett rightly argued in a concurring opinion that "the result is unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service," and said Congress or the Supreme Court could intervene to "avoid trapping Internet regulation in technological anachronism."
technological.translationZh: 但帕特里夏·米利特法官在其协同意见中正确指出，"这一结果脱离了现代宽带服务的实际情况"，并表示国会或最高法院可进行干预，以"避免将互联网监管困在技术时代错误之中"。
technological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

technological.sentenceEn: In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines.
technological.translationZh: 在过去技术发生剧烈变革的时代，企业家们通过想出将劳动力与机器结合的方法，推动了这一转型过程。
technological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

technological.sentenceEn: Optimists point out that technological upheaval has benefited workers in the past.
technological.translationZh: 乐观主义者指出，过去的技术变革一直使工人受益。
technological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

technological.sentenceEn: Technological innovation is integral to economic success.
technological.translationZh: 技术创新是经济成功不可或缺的组成部分。

tough.sentenceEn: Experts say it is tougher to distinguish oneself in a school-affiliated extracurricular activity that is common among high school students than it is to stand out while doing an uncommon activity.
tough.translationZh: 专家表示，在高中生普遍参与的学校附属课外活动中脱颖而出，要比通过一项不常见的活动崭露头角更加困难。
tough.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

tough.sentenceEn: Regenerative products could be a hard sell, because the concept is tough to define quickly, says Julie Stanton, associate professor of agricultural economics at Pennsylvania State University Brandywine.
tough.translationZh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学布兰德万恩分校农业经济学副教授朱莉·斯坦顿表示，再生农业产品可能很难推广，因为这个概念难以快速定义。
tough.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

tough.sentenceEn: It's a tough learning curve and it won't always make you popular.
tough.translationZh: 这是一个艰难的适应过程，而且不一定会让你广受欢迎。
tough.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

tough.sentenceEn: That means more battles like the one now going on between the Justice Department and California, which enacted a tough net neutrality law in the wake of the FCC's abdication.
tough.translationZh: 这意味着将会有更多类似目前司法部与加利福尼亚州之间正在进行的斗争，后者在联邦通信委员会放弃监管后颁布了一项严格的网络中立性法律。
tough.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

tough.sentenceEn: Think about how tough it is to get together 15 people, much less 50, who all get along perfectly.
tough.translationZh: 试想一下，要让15个人和谐相处已经够难了，更别说50个人了。
tough.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

tough.sentenceEn: The supply of seeds is a tough problem that has to be dealt with.
tough.translationZh: 种子供应是一个必须解决的棘手问题。

tradition.sentenceEn: Even if families don't sit down to eat together as frequently as before, millions of Britons will nonetheless have got a share this weekend of one of that nation's great traditions : the Sunday roast.
tradition.translationZh: 即便家庭成员不像以前那样频繁围坐一起用餐，但数百万英国人本周末仍会共同享用一项国家传统美食：周日烤肉大餐。
tradition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

tradition.sentenceEn: A native literary drama had been created, its alliance with the public playhouses established, and at least some of its great traditions had been begun.
tradition.translationZh: 一种本土文学戏剧已然诞生，它与公共剧院的联盟关系业已确立，其伟大传统中至少有一部分也已开端。
tradition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

tradition.sentenceEn: Across the Atlantic came successive groups of Englishmen, Frenchmen, Germans, Scots, Irishmen, Dutchmen, Swedes, and many others who attempted to transplant their habits and traditions to the new world.
tradition.translationZh: 一批又一批的英国人、法国人、德国人、苏格兰人、爱尔兰人、荷兰人、瑞典人以及其他许多民族的人们穿越大西洋，试图将他们的生活习惯和传统移植到这个新世界。
tradition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

tradition.sentenceEn: Derek Jarman's yellow-tinted film Towards Avebury, a collection of long, mostly still shots of the Wiltshire landscape, evokes a tradition of English landscape painting stretching from Samuel Palmer to Paul Nash.
tradition.translationZh: 德里克·贾曼的泛黄影片《走向埃夫伯里》由一系列威尔特郡 landscape 的长镜头（大多为静止画面）组成，它唤起了一段从塞缪尔·帕尔默延伸至保罗·纳什的英国 landscape 绘画传统。
tradition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

tradition.sentenceEn: This was the biographical tradition which Niccolò Machiavelli turned on its head.
tradition.translationZh: 而尼可罗·马基雅维利却彻底颠覆了这一传记传统。
tradition.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

testing.sentenceEn: Brian Berry, chief executive of the Federation of Master Builders, says the measures will require new materials, testing methods, products and systems to be installed.
testing.translationZh: 英国建筑大师联合会首席执行官布莱恩·贝里表示，这些措施将要求安装新的材料、测试方法、产品和系统。
testing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

testing.sentenceEn: All he needs to do is shell out $30 for a paternity testing kit (PTK) at his local drugstore – and another $120 to get the results.
testing.translationZh: 他只需在当地药店花30美元购买一套亲子鉴定试剂盒（PTK），再支付120美元即可获得检测结果。
testing.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
testing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

testing.sentenceEn: DNA testing is also the latest rage among passionate genealogists – and supports businesses that offer to search for a family's geographic roots.
testing.translationZh: DNA检测也成为了狂热系谱学家们的新宠——同时也催生了一些提供家族地理根源追溯服务的企业。
testing.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
testing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

testing.sentenceEn: Critics also argue that commercial genetic testing is only as good as the reference collections to which a sample is compared.
testing.translationZh: 批评者还认为，商业基因检测的准确性取决于用于样本比对的参考数据库。

testing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

testing.sentenceEn: The current emphasis on standardized testing highlights analysis and procedure, meaning that few of us inherently use our innovative and collaborative modes of thought.
testing.translationZh: 当前对标准化测试的重视，突出了分析和程序化思维，这意味着我们中很少有人会本能地运用创新和协作的思维模式。
testing.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
testing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

testing.sentenceEn: Most tests require collecting cells by swabbing saliva in the mouth and sending it to the company for testing .
testing.translationZh: 大多数检测都需要从口腔中提取唾液样本收集细胞，然后将其寄往公司进行检测。
testing.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
testing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

teaching.sentenceEn: A return to that version of scientific literacy, which focused more on teaching what science is and how it works and less on memorizing scientific facts, seems like something society today desperately needs.
teaching.translationZh: 回归到这种科学素养的版本，即更多地关注传授科学的本质及其运作方式，而非死记硬背科学事实，似乎正是当今社会迫切需要的。
teaching.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

teaching.sentenceEn: Although these efforts were aimed at the nonscience-bound student, they never really made their way into mainstream thought and public discourse as a means to rally widespread support for the importance of science teaching in schools.
teaching.translationZh: 尽管这些努力旨在针对非科学专业的学生，但它们从未真正进入主流思想和公共舆论，未能成为一种在学校中争取广泛支持科学教育重要性的手段。
teaching.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

teaching.sentenceEn: While hunter-gatherer children learnt from observation and imitation in mixed-age playgroups, researchers said that western "instructive teaching ", where pupils are asked to sit still, may contribute to conditions such as attention deficit hyperactivity disorder.
teaching.translationZh: 研究人员指出，狩猎采集社会的儿童在混龄游戏群体中通过观察和模仿学习，而西方要求学生静坐的“指导性教学”可能会导致注意缺陷多动障碍等问题。
teaching.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

teaching.sentenceEn: Schwitzgebel suspects the greatest impact came from social influence—classmates or teaching assistants leading the discussions may have shared their own vegetarianism, showing it as achievable or more common.
teaching.translationZh: 施维茨格贝尔认为，影响主要来自社会层面——主持讨论的同学或助教可能分享了自己的素食主义生活方式，让大家觉得素食不仅可行，还相当普遍。
teaching.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

teaching.sentenceEn: Now the researchers are probing the specific effects of teaching style, teaching assistants' eating habits and students' video exposure.
teaching.translationZh: 目前，研究人员正在深入探究教学风格、助教饮食习惯以及学生观看视频情况所产生的具体影响。
teaching.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

therefore.sentenceEn: The researchers are convinced that the elephants always know precisely where they are in relation to all the resources they need, and can therefore take shortcuts, as well as following familiar routes.
therefore.translationZh: 研究人员确信，大象总能精确地知道自己相对于所需资源的位置，因此它们既能走熟悉的路线，也能抄近路。
therefore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

therefore.sentenceEn: Therefore , unless customers are prepared to sign release agreements, the use of AI may become somewhat restricted in the future.
therefore.translationZh: 因此，除非客户愿意签署数据使用授权协议，否则人工智能的应用在未来可能会受到一定限制。
therefore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

therefore.sentenceEn: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol.
therefore.translationZh: 然而，人造草坪的支持者指出，天然草坪也会对环境产生影响，因为它们需要修剪，因此通常会消耗电力或汽油。
therefore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

therefore.sentenceEn: Light was something that both artists and scientists had an interest in, and therefore could form the basis of collaboration.
therefore.translationZh: 光正是艺术家和科学家共同感兴趣的东西，因此可以成为合作的基础。
therefore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

therefore.sentenceEn: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers' wages.
therefore.translationZh: 即便没有将工作置于风险之中，就业保护法只要在一定程度上限制企业主解雇表现不佳的管理人员，就会对企业生产力构成制约，进而影响工人工资。
therefore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

therefore.sentenceEn: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable.
therefore.translationZh: 在诸多缺陷中，当城市被迫独自应对空气污染问题时所必须采取的措施具有政治争议性，因此很容易被推翻。
therefore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

talent.sentenceEn: Persuading studios to film here would become much more challenging if we couldn't offer a deep bench of local film workers, on-screen talent and local businesses that support the entertainment industry.
talent.translationZh: 如果我们无法提供由本地影视从业人员、出镜人才以及支持娱乐产业的本地企业构成的深厚人才储备，那么说服制片厂来此拍摄将会变得更加困难。
talent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

talent.sentenceEn: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue.
talent.translationZh: 如果南加州的制片量长期低于临界水平，该行业的核心人才将会流失，同时还会伴随巨额收入的损失。
talent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

talent.sentenceEn: Experts say demonstrating talent in at least one extracurricular activity can help in the college admissions process, especially at top-tier undergraduate institutions.
talent.translationZh: 专家表示，在至少一项课外活动中展现才华有助于大学申请，尤其是在顶尖本科院校的申请过程中。
talent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

talent.sentenceEn: Their teams of engineers stayed on, making them two of the many "acqui-hires" that the biggest companies have used to feed their great hunger for tech talent .
talent.translationZh: 这两家公司的工程师团队留了下来，使它们成为科技巨头为满足其对技术人才的巨大渴求而进行的众多'人才收购'案例中的两个。
talent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

talent.sentenceEn: The best model for understanding the growth of CEO pay is that of limited CEO talent in a world where business opportunities for the top firms are growing rapidly.
talent.translationZh: 理解CEO薪酬增长的最佳模型是：在顶级公司的商业机会迅速增长的世界中，CEO人才却相对有限。
talent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

talent.sentenceEn: While he obviously had an abundance of natural talent , the final, polished work that he gave to the world was the result of years of practicing, re-writing and reading.
talent.translationZh: 虽然他显然天赋异禀，但呈现在世人面前的那些精良作品，是他多年练习、重写与阅读的成果。
talent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

technique.sentenceEn: Every day, scientists, technologists and engineers are discovering new ways to exploit renewable energy sources and develop techniques not just to use power more intelligently but to power our intelligence.
technique.translationZh: 每天，科学家、技术专家和工程师都在探索利用可再生能源的新方法，并开发相关技术——不仅是为了更智能地使用能源，也是为了用能源驱动我们的智能发展。
technique.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

technique.sentenceEn: Since the 1960s, underwater archaeology techniques and tools had made huge advances.
technique.translationZh: 自20世纪60年代以来，水下考古技术和工具取得了巨大进步。
technique.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

technique.sentenceEn: The crude technique required educated guesses on exposure times, and involved heavy, awkward equipment—several men had to assist in its transportation.
technique.translationZh: 这种原始技术需要凭经验猜测曝光时间，并且所使用的设备笨重难携——需要好几个人帮忙搬运。

technique.sentenceEn: These eggs, which are making their debut now on shelves for as much as $8 a dozen, are still labeled organic and animal-friendly, but they're also from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils that can trap greenhouse gases.
technique.translationZh: 这些鸡蛋目前首次上架销售，售价高达8美元一打。它们仍被贴上有机和动物友好的标签，但其特别之处在于，这些鸡蛋来自采用再生农业的农场——这种农场运用特殊技术培育肥沃土壤，从而能够捕获温室气体。
technique.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

technique.sentenceEn: Changes in the light, the limitations of your painting materials, and the lack of experience and technique mean that what you start out trying to achieve may not come to life the way that you expected.
technique.translationZh: 光线的变化、绘画材料的局限，以及经验和技巧的不足，都意味着你最初试图达成的效果可能无法如预期般呈现。
technique.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

technique.sentenceEn: What makes the problem thornier is that the usual time-management techniques don't seem sufficient.
technique.translationZh: 让这个问题更棘手的是，通常的时间管理技巧似乎并不够用。
technique.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

transform.sentenceEn: Solar panels had a few niche uses until they became cheap; now they are transforming the global energy system.
transform.translationZh: 太阳能电池板在价格亲民之前仅有少数特定用途；如今，它们正在改变全球能源系统。
transform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

transform.sentenceEn: The Gutenberg printing press transformed civilisation not by changing the nature of writing but by changing its cost—and it would have achieved little without a parallel collapse in the price of surfaces to write on, thanks to an often-overlooked technology called paper.
transform.translationZh: 古腾堡印刷机改变了文明，并非通过改变书写的本质，而是通过改变其成本——如果没有另一种常被忽视的技术（即纸张）导致书写载体价格的同步暴跌，印刷机也难以取得多大成就。
transform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

transform.sentenceEn: They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light.
transform.translationZh: 它们改变了当地居民的愿景抱负；它们将城市的自我形象推向更大胆、更乐观的新高度。
transform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

transform.sentenceEn: The success of Sci-Hub, which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves legally accessed, shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed so that it works for all participants.
transform.translationZh: Sci-Hub的成功依赖于研究人员分享自己合法获取的论文副本，这表明现行法律生态系统已在用户中失去合法性，必须进行改革以服务于所有参与者。
transform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

transform.sentenceEn: It is not, however, a sign that they're getting serious about transforming the postal system for the 21st century.
transform.translationZh: 然而，这并不意味着他们正认真考虑为21世纪改革邮政系统。
transform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

transform.sentenceEn: Tim Harford, author of Messy: The Power of Disorder to Transform Our Lives, points to a study in the early 1980s that divided undergraduates into two groups: some were advised to set out monthly goals and study activities; others were told to plan activities and goals in much more detail, day by day.
transform.translationZh: 《混乱：无序的力量如何改变我们的生活》一书的作者蒂姆·哈福德提到20世纪80年代初的一项研究，该研究将大学生分为两组：一组被建议制定月度目标和学习活动；另一组则被要求更详细地规划每日活动和目标。
transform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

typical.sentenceEn: A typical digital SLR camera shoots 20 frames a second.
typical.translationZh: 一款典型的数码单反相机每秒可拍摄20帧。

typical.sentenceEn: We know that a typical infant will instinctively gaze into its mother's eyes, and she will look back.
typical.translationZh: 我们知道，普通婴儿会本能地凝视母亲的眼睛，而母亲也会回以注视。
typical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

typical.sentenceEn: It is true that CEO pay has gone up—top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers on average, and since the mid-1970s, CEO pay for large publicly traded American corporations has, by varying estimates, gone up by about 500%.
typical.translationZh: 确实，首席执行官的薪酬有所上涨——顶级CEO的薪酬平均可能是普通员工的300倍，而且自20世纪70年代中期以来，据各种不同估计，美国大型上市公司首席执行官的薪酬上涨了约500%。
typical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

typical.sentenceEn: The typical CEO of a top American corporation now makes about $18.9 million a year.
typical.translationZh: 如今，美国顶级企业首席执行官的年薪约为1890万美元。
typical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

typical.sentenceEn: "We estimate that either eliminating a substantial labour-rights concern, such as child labour, or increasing corporate giving by about 20% results in fines that generally are 40% lower than the typical punishment for bribing foreign officials," says one researcher.
typical.translationZh: 一位研究人员表示：“我们估计，无论是消除重大劳工权益问题（如童工问题），还是将企业捐赠增加约20%，通常都能使罚款比贿赂外国官员的典型惩罚降低40%。”
typical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

typical.sentenceEn: What is the typical trend of businesses today?
typical.translationZh: 当今企业的典型发展趋势是什么？
typical.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）

trace.sentenceEn: Tracing the history of the term, we can see how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time, muddying the waters when it comes to determining the goals of science education.
trace.translationZh: 追溯该术语的历史可以发现，科学素养的定义随着时间的推移发生了变化，这使得在确定科学教育的目标时，情况变得更加复杂且模糊不清。
trace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

trace.sentenceEn: Now, researchers have used genomes of over 200 donkeys to trace their domestication back to a single event around 7,000 years ago in East Africa — about 3,000 years before humans tamed horses.
trace.translationZh: 现在，研究人员通过对 200 多头驴的基因组进行分析，追溯到它们的驯化起源于约 7000 年前东非的一次单一事件——这比人类驯服马的时间早了约 3000 年。
trace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

trace.sentenceEn: They then traced how the animals spread across the rest of the continent into Europe and Asia about 2,500 years later.
trace.translationZh: 随后，他们追踪了这些动物在大约 2,500 年后是如何穿过大陆其余地区，进而扩散到欧洲和亚洲的。
trace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

trace.sentenceEn: The development of the Elizabethan drama for the next twenty-five years is of exceptional interest to students of literary history, for in this brief period we may trace the beginning, growth, blossoming, and decay of many kinds of plays, and of many great careers.
trace.translationZh: 伊丽莎白时期戏剧在接下来二十五年的发展，对于文学史研究者而言具有非凡的意义，因为在这短暂的时期内，我们可以追溯到多种戏剧类型以及众多伟大职业生涯的开端、成长、繁荣与衰落。
trace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

trace.sentenceEn: In Oliver Twist, he traces an orphan's progress from the workhouse to the criminal slums of London.
trace.translationZh: 在《雾都孤儿》中，他追踪了一名孤儿从济贫院到伦敦犯罪贫民窟的人生历程。

trace.sentenceEn: Some sites keep E-mailing job seekers to trace their demands.
trace.translationZh: 有些网站不断给求职者发送电子邮件，以追踪他们的需求。
trace.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）

trait.sentenceEn: The researchers studied "prosocial" and rebellious traits in more than 200 children and young adults, ranging from 11 to 28 years old.
trait.translationZh: 研究人员对200多名11至28岁的儿童和年轻人的“亲社会”特质与叛逆特质进行了研究。
trait.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

trait.sentenceEn: In a 2019 survey of University of Georgia students, meanwhile, the career office found the most desirable trait in a future employer was the ability to offer secure employment (followed by professional development and training, and then inspiring purpose).
trait.translationZh: 与此同时，乔治亚大学就业指导办公室在2019年对本校学生的一项调查中发现，未来雇主最令人向往的特质是能够提供稳定的工作（其次是专业发展和培训，然后是鼓舞人心的目标）。
trait.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

trait.sentenceEn: The United States is the product of two principal forces – the immigration of European peoples with their varied ideas, customs, and national characteristics and the impact of a new country which modified these traits .
trait.translationZh: 美国是两种主要力量共同作用的产物——一是带着各种思想、习俗和民族特质的欧洲移民潮，二是这个新国家对这些特质所产生的影响。
trait.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

trait.sentenceEn: But a comparative study of linguistic traits published online today supplies a reality check.
trait.translationZh: 但今日在线发表的一项语言特征比较研究为我们提供了现实检验。
trait.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

trait.sentenceEn: The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality, identifying traits (particularly in word order) shared by many languages, which are considered to represent biases that result from cognitive constraints.
trait.translationZh: 第二次尝试由乔舒亚·格林伯格提出，他采用了更为经验主义的方法来研究语言普遍性，识别出许多语言共有的特征（尤其是在词序方面），这些特征被认为体现了由认知限制所导致的偏好。
trait.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

trait.sentenceEn: Their work makes a rather startling assertion: the trait we commonly call talent is highly overrated.
trait.translationZh: 他们的研究得出了一个相当惊人的结论：我们通常所说的天赋被严重高估了。
trait.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
trait.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

trial.sentenceEn: The randomised control trial involved hundreds of year 5 pupils aged nine and ten—at 45 state primary schools that had not been "previously exposed to RSC pedagogy".
trial.translationZh: 这项随机对照试验涉及45所州立小学的数百名9至10岁五年级学生，这些学校此前"未接触过皇家莎士比亚剧团教学法"。
trial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

trial.sentenceEn: Across 18 trials each, the living rats were 52 percent more likely on average to set the social robot free than the asocial one.
trial.translationZh: 在每组18次试验中，活鼠释放社交型机器人的平均可能性比释放非社交型机器人高出52%。
trial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

trial.sentenceEn: For one trial , each participant was shown a pile of pens that the researcher claimed were from a previous experiment.
trial.translationZh: 在其中一项试验中，研究人员向每位参与者展示了一堆钢笔，并声称这些钢笔来自之前的一项实验。
trial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

trial.sentenceEn: The high court's decision said the judge in Mr. McDonnell's trial failed to tell a jury that it must look only at his "official acts," or the former governor's decisions on "specific" and "unsettled" issues related to his duties.
trial.translationZh: 最高法院的裁决指出，麦克唐纳案的主审法官未能告知陪审团，他们只需考量麦克唐纳的“公务行为”，即这位前州长在与其职责相关的“具体”且“未决”问题上的决策。
trial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

trial.sentenceEn: Parkun is not a race but a time trial : Your only competitor is the clock.
trial.translationZh: 公园跑不是一场竞速比赛，而是一场计时赛：你唯一的竞争对手就是时钟。
trial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

typically.sentenceEn: He typically takes between 10,000 and 20,000 shots to get one butterfly take-off sequence in focus.
typically.translationZh: 他通常需要拍摄1万到2万张照片，才能获得一个清晰的蝴蝶起飞镜头序列。

typically.sentenceEn: The health information these apps and health data tracking wearables are collecting typically does not receive the same legal protections.
typically.translationZh: 这些应用程序和健康数据追踪可穿戴设备收集的健康信息通常得不到同等的法律保护。
typically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

typically.sentenceEn: They were typically located outside the walls of a city or village and were usually funded by local governments or privately.
typically.translationZh: 它们通常位于城市或村庄的城墙之外，资金来源一般为当地政府或私人出资。
typically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

typically.sentenceEn: In the movies and on television, artificial intelligence is typically depicted as something sinister that will upend our way of life.
typically.translationZh: 在电影和电视中，人工智能通常被描绘成某种险恶的事物，将会颠覆我们的生活方式。
typically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

typically.sentenceEn: Typically , if rains are delayed, people may clear land to plant more rice to supplement their harvests.
typically.translationZh: 通常情况下，如果降雨推迟，人们可能会开垦土地来种植更多水稻以补充收成。
typically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

typically.sentenceEn: These pauses typically occur at about three per second, and the eyes then jump to another spot, until several important points in the image are registered like a series of snapshots.
typically.translationZh: 这些注视停顿通常每秒约三次，随后眼睛会跳转到另一个位置，直到图像中的几个重要点像一系列快照一样被记录下来。
typically.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

technical.sentenceEn: The International Association of Scientific, Technical and Medical Publishers says that there are more than 2,000 publishers worldwide specializing in these subjects.
technical.translationZh: 国际科学、技术与医学出版商协会表示，全球有超过2000家出版商专门从事这些领域的出版。
technical.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
technical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

technical.sentenceEn: "Setting the proper investment level for security, redundancy, and recovery is a management issue, not a technical one," he says.
technical.translationZh: 他表示：“为安全防护、冗余备份和数据恢复设立恰当的投资水平是管理问题，而非技术问题。”
technical.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
technical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

technical.sentenceEn: The mergers of telecom companies, such as WorldCom, hardly seem to bring higher prices for consumers or a reduction in the pace of technical progress.
technical.translationZh: 像世通这样的电信公司合并，似乎很难给消费者带来更高的价格，也不会减缓技术进步的步伐。
technical.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
technical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

technical.sentenceEn: Scientists tend to forget this when writing their cut and dried reports for the technical journals, but history is filled with examples of it.
technical.translationZh: 科学家们在为技术期刊撰写那些刻板的报告时，往往会忘记这一点，但历史上这样的例子俯拾皆是。
technical.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
technical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

technical.sentenceEn: Also common in the natural sciences, the technicist fallacy mistakenly identifies the discipline as a whole with certain parts of its technical implementation.
technical.translationZh: 技术主义谬误在自然科学领域同样常见，它错误地将整个学科与该学科技术实施过程中的某些部分等同起来。
technical.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
technical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

technical.translationZh: 主播们失去了他们的技术优势。

thrive.sentenceEn: Climate change is a driving factor in the push to restore forests, but it also raises questions, such as where trees can thrive in the future.
thrive.translationZh: 气候变化是推动森林恢复的一个驱动因素，但也引发了一些问题，例如未来哪些地方适合树木生长。
thrive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

thrive.sentenceEn: But the remaining trees draw a greater share of the available moisture, so they grow and thrive , restoring the forest's capacity to pull carbon from the air.
thrive.translationZh: 但剩余的树木会吸收更多可用水分，因此它们能够茁壮成长，进而恢复森林从空气中吸收碳的能力。
thrive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

thrive.sentenceEn: Instead of wordy, worthy strategies, future governments need to do more to provide the conditions for sport to thrive .
thrive.translationZh: 未来的政府不应再制定冗长而华而不实的策略，而需要做更多工作来为体育事业的蓬勃发展创造条件。
thrive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

thrive.sentenceEn: In the meantime, thriving Spanish colonies had been established in Mexico, the West Indies, and South America.
thrive.translationZh: 与此同时，西班牙人已在墨西哥、西印度群岛和南美洲建立起繁荣的殖民地。
thrive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

thrive.sentenceEn: In fact, these commutes were reportedly more enjoyable compared with those without communication, which makes absolute sense, since human beings thrive off of social connections.
thrive.translationZh: 事实上，据报道，这些通勤比没有交流的通勤更愉快，这完全合乎情理，因为人类依靠社会联系而茁壮成长。
thrive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

thrive.translationZh: 有关节食的网站将会蓬勃发展。

timber.sentenceEn: "This is a really, really critical issue for restoration in Southeast Asia, because many of the most important timber species and tree species — the ones that will lock up the most carbon — they're all masting species."
timber.translationZh: 对于东南亚的生态修复工作而言，这是一个极其关键的问题。因为许多最重要的木材物种和树种——也就是那些固碳能力最强的树种——全部都属于‘大年结实’物种。
timber.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

timber.sentenceEn: While around three quarters of Scottish homes are built from Scottish timber , the use of home-grown wood in England is only around 25 percent.
timber.translationZh: 虽然约四分之三的苏格兰房屋使用苏格兰本地木材建造，但英格兰使用本土木材的比例仅为25%左右。
timber.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

timber.sentenceEn: Currently only 20 percent of the UK's wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world.
timber.translationZh: 目前，英国木材需求量中仅有20%来自本土供应，而该国仍是全球第二大木材净进口国。
timber.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

timber.sentenceEn: The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country's reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations.
timber.translationZh: 这家林业和木材行业机构呼吁采取紧急行动，以减少该国对木材进口的依赖，并为子孙后代提供稳定的木材供应。
timber.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

timber.sentenceEn: Coming at a time of fresh incentives from the UK government for landowners to grow more trees, the trade body says these don't go far enough and fail to promote the benefits of planting them to boost timber supplies.
timber.translationZh: 尽管英国政府最近出台了鼓励土地所有者多种树的新激励措施，但该行业机构表示，这些措施力度不够，未能充分宣传植树对增加木材供应的益处。
timber.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

timber.sentenceEn: Some species of trees have been "read out of the party" by economics-minded foresters because they grow too slowly, or have too low a sale value to pay as timber crops.
timber.translationZh: 一些树种已被经济头脑的林业工作者“开除出局”，因为它们生长过于缓慢，或作为木材作物的销售价值太低，得不偿失。
timber.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

tendency.sentenceEn: Attempts have been made to curb this tendency , for example, by trying to incorporate some measure of quality as well as quantity into the assessment of an applicant's papers.
tendency.translationZh: 人们已尝试遏制这种趋势，例如在评估申请者的论文时，既要考量数量，也要纳入质量衡量标准。
tendency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

tendency.sentenceEn: Using caregiver assessments and the children's self-observations, she rated each child's overall sympathy level and his or her tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions.
tendency.translationZh: 她通过照料者的评估和孩子们的自我观察，对每个孩子的整体同情心水平以及在道德失范行为后产生负面情绪的倾向进行了评分。
tendency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

tendency.sentenceEn: The findings do not simply explain people's tendency to befriend those of similar ethnic backgrounds, say the researchers.
tendency.translationZh: 研究人员表示，这些发现并不能简单地解释人们倾向于与相似种族背景的人交朋友的现象。
tendency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

tendency.sentenceEn: Today we have a(n) tendency to label obesity as a disgrace.
tendency.translationZh: 如今，我们往往将肥胖视为一种耻辱。
tendency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

tendency.sentenceEn: This tendency in the natural sciences has long been evident in the social sciences too.
tendency.translationZh: 自然科学领域的这种倾向，在社会科学领域也早已显现。
tendency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

tendency.sentenceEn: Building on this basic truth about interpersonal influence, the researchers studied the dynamics of social influence by conducting thousands of computer simulations of populations, manipulating a number of variables relating to people's ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced.
tendency.translationZh: 基于这一人际影响的基本事实，研究人员通过对人群进行数千次计算机模拟，操纵了若干与人们影响他人的能力以及被他人影响的倾向相关的变量，以此来研究社会影响的动态变化。
tendency.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

tolerant.sentenceEn: A more practical goal is to try, to the best of your ability, to be as tolerant and composed as you can when faced with trying situations involving your children.
tolerant.translationZh: 一个更实际的目标是，在面对与孩子相关的棘手情况时，尽你所能地保持宽容和冷静。
tolerant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

tolerant.sentenceEn: Sometimes parents get exhausted and frustrated and are unable to maintain a tolerant and composed style with their kids.
tolerant.translationZh: 有时候父母会感到疲惫和沮丧，无法对孩子保持宽容和冷静的态度。
tolerant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

tolerant.sentenceEn: In many respects, the U.S. was more socially tolerant entering this recession than at any time in its history, and a variety of national polls on social conflict since then have shown mixed results.
tolerant.translationZh: 在许多方面，美国进入本次经济衰退时的社会宽容度比历史上任何时期都要高，而自那时以来，各种关于社会冲突的全国性民意调查显示的结果却好坏参半。
tolerant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

trail.sentenceEn: Animal desire paths, such as ducks forging trails through frozen ponds or dogs carving direct routes in gardens, highlight the adaptability of these trails in both human and animal experiences.
trail.translationZh: 动物的自然路径，例如鸭子在结冰的池塘中开辟出的水道，或是狗在花园里踏出的捷径，凸显了这类路径在人类与动物体验中所展现的适应性。
trail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

trail.sentenceEn: The Wickquasgeck Trail is an example of a historical desire path, created by Native Americans to cross the forests of Manhattan and move between settlements quickly.
trail.translationZh: 威克夸斯盖克小径是历史上"欲望路径"的一个例证，由美洲原住民开辟，用于穿越曼哈顿森林并在各定居点之间快速往返。
trail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

trail.sentenceEn: This trail , when Dutch colonists arrived, was widened and made into one of the main trade roads across the island, known at the time as de Heere Straat, or Gentlemen's Street.
trail.translationZh: 荷兰殖民者到来后，这条小径被拓宽，成为横贯全岛的主要贸易通道之一，当时被称为de Heere Straat，即“绅士街”。
trail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

trail.sentenceEn: Roads, trails , restrooms, visitor centers and other infrastructure are crumbling.
trail.translationZh: 道路、步道、卫生间、游客中心及其他基础设施都在日渐破败。
trail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

trail.sentenceEn: Trail blazes, tire tracks, and other features can lead you to civilization.
trail.translationZh: 小径标记、轮胎轨迹和其他特征能引导你找到人烟之处。
trail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

trail.sentenceEn: When you find yourself well off a trail , but not in a completely unfamiliar area, you have to answer two questions: Which way is downhill, in this particular area?
trail.translationZh: 当你发现自己远离了步道，但又并非身处完全陌生的区域时，你必须回答两个问题：在这片特定区域，哪条路是下坡？
trail.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

trap.sentenceEn: The reach of art-science tie-ups needs to go beyond the necessary purpose of research communication, and participants must not fall into the trap of stereotyping each other.
trap.translationZh: 艺术与科学合作的影响范围需要超越研究传播这一必要目的，并且参与者不应陷入对彼此产生刻板印象的误区。
trap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

trap.sentenceEn: These eggs, which are making their debut now on shelves for as much as $8 a dozen, are still labeled organic and animal-friendly, but they're also from birds that live on farms using regenerative agriculture—special techniques to cultivate rich soils that can trap greenhouse gases.
trap.translationZh: 这些鸡蛋目前首次上架销售，售价高达8美元一打。它们仍被贴上有机和动物友好的标签，但其特别之处在于，这些鸡蛋来自采用再生农业的农场——这种农场运用特殊技术培育肥沃土壤，从而能够捕获温室气体。
trap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

trap.sentenceEn: But Judge Patricia Millett rightly argued in a concurring opinion that "the result is unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service," and said Congress or the Supreme Court could intervene to "avoid trapping Internet regulation in technological anachronism."
trap.translationZh: 但帕特里夏·米利特法官在其协同意见中正确指出，"这一结果脱离了现代宽带服务的实际情况"，并表示国会或最高法院可进行干预，以"避免将互联网监管困在技术时代错误之中"。
trap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

trap.sentenceEn: This could lead to the rats better remembering having freed it earlier, and wanting the robot to return the favour when they get trapped , she says.
trap.translationZh: 她说，这可能会让老鼠更好地记住自己之前释放过社交机器人，并希望在自己被困时机器人能回报这份恩情。
trap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

trap.sentenceEn: Next, the researchers trapped the robots in cages and gave the rats the opportunity to release them by pressing a lever.
trap.translationZh: 接下来，研究人员将机器人关进笼子，并给老鼠们通过按压杠杆来释放它们的机会。
trap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

trap.sentenceEn: It set the trapped rats free.
trap.translationZh: 它会打开笼门，让被困的老鼠逃脱。

trick.sentenceEn: Think about the times you felt tricked or frustrated by a membership or subscription that had a seamless sign-up process but was later difficult to cancel.
trick.translationZh: 想想那些让你感到被欺骗或沮丧的时刻：某个会员或订阅服务注册过程异常顺畅，可后来却难以取消。
trick.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

trick.sentenceEn: The trick is not only to specify just one or even two dimensions of the objective, but also to understand how to help people better achieve the objective.
trick.translationZh: 关键在于不仅要明确目标的一个甚至两个维度，还要理解如何帮助人们更好地实现目标。
trick.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

trick.sentenceEn: If you get lost without a phone or a compass, and you literally can't find north, we have a few tricks to help you navigate back to civilization, one of which is to follow the land.
trick.translationZh: 如果你迷了路，既没有手机也没有指南针，而且真的找不到北，我们有几个技巧可以帮助你回到文明世界，其中之一就是顺着地形走。
trick.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

trick.sentenceEn: None of these tricks will help you understand them, their positions or the issues that divide you, but they can help you win – in one way.
trick.translationZh: 这些伎俩都无法帮助你理解对方、他们的立场或导致你们产生分歧的问题，但在某种意义上，它们确实能帮你"赢"。

trick.sentenceEn: Among the children who had not been tricked , the majority were willing to cooperate with the tester in learning a new skill, demonstrating that they trusted his leadership.
trick.translationZh: 在未被欺骗的孩子中，大多数愿意与测试者合作学习新技能，这表明他们信任测试者的引导。
trick.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

trick.sentenceEn: This is apparently the reason McDonald's restricts the availability of its popular McRib – a marketing trick that has turned the pork sandwich into an object of obsession.
trick.translationZh: 这显然就是麦当劳限制其人气产品McRib（麦辣猪排堡）供应的原因——这一营销手段已将这款猪肉三明治变成了令人痴迷的对象。
trick.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

trigger.sentenceEn: In some areas, high daytime temperatures alone might serve as an adequate trigger for alerts.
trigger.translationZh: 在某些地区，仅日间高温就可能足以触发警报。
trigger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

trigger.sentenceEn: And their triggering thresholds often are not customized to the local climate.
trigger.translationZh: 而且它们的触发阈值往往没有根据当地气候进行定制。
trigger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

trigger.sentenceEn: Other life changes can trigger periods of loneliness too, such as retirement, changing jobs or becoming a parent.
trigger.translationZh: 其他生活变化也可能引发孤独期，例如退休、换工作或成为父母。
trigger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

trigger.sentenceEn: Though plants lack brains, the firing of electrical signals in their stems and leaves nonetheless triggered responses that hinted at consciousness, researchers previously reported.
trigger.translationZh: 研究人员此前曾报告称，尽管植物没有大脑，但其茎和叶中电信号的传递仍会引发暗示意识存在的反应。
trigger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

trigger.sentenceEn: In people who score high in a test of neuroticism, a personality dimension associated with self-consciousness and anxiety, eye contact triggered more activity associated with avoidance, according to the Finnish researcher Jari Hietanen and colleagues.
trigger.translationZh: 芬兰研究人员亚里·希塔宁及其同事发现，在神经质测试中得分较高的人群中——神经质是一种与自我意识和焦虑相关的人格维度——眼神接触会引发更多与回避相关的活动。
trigger.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

trigger.sentenceEn: It has triggered a radical reform in commercial fisheries.
trigger.translationZh: 这引发了商业渔业的根本性改革。

telescope.sentenceEn: It was a musician who discovered the planet Uranus in the 18th century by making his own telescope with mirrors composed of copper and tin.
telescope.translationZh: 18世纪，一位音乐家亲手制作了一台由铜锡合金镜面组成的望远镜，并通过这台望远镜发现了天王星。
telescope.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

telescope.sentenceEn: But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world's most powerful telescopes .
telescope.translationZh: 但莫纳克亚山也是世界上一些最强大望远镜的所在地。
telescope.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

telescope.sentenceEn: Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going.
telescope.translationZh: 要求拆除莫纳克亚山上所有望远镜或禁止未来在那里进行开发的呼声忽视了一个事实：天文学和夏威夷文化都在试图回答关于我们是谁、我们来自何方以及我们要去往何处的重大问题。
telescope.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

telescope.sentenceEn: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity's view of the cosmos.
telescope.translationZh: 围绕三十米望远镜（TMT）的建造，抗议活动已经爆发。这是一个巨型天文台，有望彻底改变人类对宇宙的认知。
telescope.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

telescope.sentenceEn: Opposition to telescopes on Mauna Kea is nothing new.
telescope.translationZh: 反对在莫纳克亚山上建造望远镜并非新鲜事。
telescope.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

telescope.sentenceEn: To limit the number of telescopes on Mauna Kea, old ones will be removed at the end of their lifetimes and their sites returned to a natural state.
telescope.translationZh: 为了限制莫纳克亚山上望远镜的数量，旧望远镜在达到使用年限后将被拆除，其原址将恢复自然状态。
telescope.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

tolerance.sentenceEn: Scientific method, reductionism and the questioning of Church ideals was to be encouraged, as were ideas of liberty, tolerance and progress.
tolerance.translationZh: 科学方法、还原论和对教会理念的质疑应当得到鼓励，自由、宽容和进步的思想亦是如此。
tolerance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

tolerance.sentenceEn: We are all becoming increasingly aware of the importance of modeling tolerance and patience for the younger generation.
tolerance.translationZh: 我们都越来越意识到，为年轻一代树立宽容和耐心的榜样至关重要。
tolerance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

tolerance.sentenceEn: Words degraded to the margin have been justice, fairness, tolerance , proportionality and accountability.
tolerance.translationZh: 而被边缘化、失去重要性的词汇则是正义、公平、宽容、均衡和责任。
tolerance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

traditionally.sentenceEn: Libraries and archives have traditionally shouldered the responsibility of organization, preservation, and access to information.
traditionally.translationZh: 图书馆和档案馆历来肩负着信息的组织、保存与获取的责任。
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

traditionally.sentenceEn: Traditionally , this role was fulfilled by data banks, libraries, and other humans.
traditionally.translationZh: 传统上，这一角色是由数据库、图书馆和其他人来承担的。
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

traditionally.sentenceEn: State governments are well accustomed to managing forests, but traditionally they've focused on wildlife, watersheds and opportunities for recreation.
traditionally.translationZh: 州政府早已习惯于管理森林，但传统上他们的重点一直放在野生动物、流域和休闲机会上。
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

traditionally.sentenceEn: Newlyweds traditionally move in with the wife's parents and may live with them up to a year, until they can build a new house nearby.
traditionally.translationZh: 按照传统，新婚夫妇会搬去与妻子的父母同住，可能会一起生活长达一年，直到他们能够在附近建造新房为止。
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

traditionally.sentenceEn: Generally however British land artists preferred to get away from towns, gravitating towards landscapes that are traditionally considered beautiful such as the Lake District or the Wiltshire Downs.
traditionally.translationZh: 然而，英国地景艺术家总体上更倾向于远离城镇，被那些传统意义上的美景所吸引，例如湖区或威尔特郡丘陵。
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

traditionally.sentenceEn: Traditionally , legal learning has been viewed in such institutions as the special preserve of lawyers, rather than a necessary part of the intellectual equipment of an educated person.
traditionally.translationZh: 传统上，在这类院校中，法律知识一直被视为律师的专属领域，而非受过教育者知识素养的必要组成部分。
traditionally.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
traditionally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

transportation.sentenceEn: The crude technique required educated guesses on exposure times, and involved heavy, awkward equipment—several men had to assist in its transportation .
transportation.translationZh: 这种原始技术需要凭经验猜测曝光时间，并且所使用的设备笨重难携——需要好几个人帮忙搬运。

transportation.sentenceEn: A number of companies, particularly in energy and transportation , use AI image processing technology to inspect infrastructure and prevent equipment failure or leaks before they happen.
transportation.translationZh: 许多公司，特别是能源和运输行业的公司，正在使用人工智能图像处理技术来检查基础设施，并在设备故障或泄漏发生前加以预防。
transportation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

transportation.sentenceEn: In one series of studies, researchers instructed Chicago-area commuters using public transportation to strike up a conversation with someone near them.
transportation.translationZh: 在一系列研究中，研究人员指示芝加哥地区乘坐公共交通的通勤者与身边的人攀谈。
transportation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

transportation.sentenceEn: New research on transportation biofuels is already under way.
transportation.translationZh: 关于交通生物燃料的新研究已经在进行中。
transportation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

transportation.sentenceEn: Last year, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) found in a secret check that undercover investigators were able to sneak weapons – both fake and real – past airport security nearly every time they tried.
transportation.translationZh: 去年，美国运输安全管理局(TSA)在一次秘密检查中发现，便衣调查人员几乎每次尝试都能将武器——包括假武器和真武器——偷偷携带通过机场安检。
transportation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

transportation.sentenceEn: Shippers who feel they are being overcharged have the right to appeal to the federal government's Surface Transportation Board for rate relief, but the process is expensive, time consuming, and will work only in truly extreme cases.
transportation.translationZh: 那些觉得自己被多收费的托运商有权向联邦政府的地面运输委员会申诉，要求降低费率，但这一过程既昂贵又耗时，而且只有在真正极端的情况下才会奏效。
transportation.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
transportation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

traveler.sentenceEn: They've helped pull wheeled vehicles, carry travelers and move goods across the world.
traveler.translationZh: 它们曾帮助人们拉动轮式车辆、运送旅客以及在全球范围内搬运货物。
traveler.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

traveler.sentenceEn: But demanding too much of air travelers or providing too little security in return undermines public support for the process.
traveler.translationZh: 但如果对航空旅客要求过多，或者提供的安全保障与之不成正比，就会削弱公众对这一流程的支持。
traveler.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

traveler.sentenceEn: PreCheck is supposed to be a win-win for travelers and the TSA.
traveler.translationZh: 预检计划（PreCheck）本应是一项让旅客和美国运输安全管理局（TSA）实现双赢的举措。
traveler.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

traveler.sentenceEn: This allows the TSA to focus on travelers who are higher risk, saving time for everyone involved.
traveler.translationZh: 这使得运输安全管理局能够将重点放在高风险旅客身上，为所有相关人员节省时间。
traveler.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

traveler.sentenceEn: These travelers to North America came in small, unmercifully overcrowded craft.
traveler.translationZh: 这些前往北美的旅行者乘坐的是狭小且拥挤不堪的船只。
traveler.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

traveler.sentenceEn: They were vividly portrayed by ancient travelers .
traveler.translationZh: 古代旅行者对它们进行了生动的描绘。

tackle.sentenceEn: "There is a coalition growing within artist industries to figure out how to tackle or mitigate this," says Ortiz.
tackle.translationZh: 奥尔蒂斯表示：“艺术家行业内部正在形成一个联盟，以研究如何应对或缓解这一问题。”
tackle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

tackle.sentenceEn: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable.
tackle.translationZh: 在诸多缺陷中，当城市被迫独自应对空气污染问题时所必须采取的措施具有政治争议性，因此很容易被推翻。
tackle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

tackle.sentenceEn: When social scientists do tackle practical issues, their scope is often local: Belgium is interested mainly in the effects of poverty on Belgium, for example.
tackle.translationZh: 当社会科学家确实着手解决实际问题时，他们的研究范围往往局限于本地：例如，比利时的研究主要关注贫困对比利时本国的影响。
tackle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

tackle.sentenceEn: Which is considered a weakness of the city-level measures to tackle dirty air?
tackle.translationZh: 城市层面解决空气污染的措施被认为存在什么缺点？

tackle.sentenceEn: they have to tackle financial difficulties.
tackle.translationZh: 他们必须应对财务困难。

townsfolk.sentenceEn: The townsfolk don't see it this way and the local council does not contribute directly to the subsidy of the Royal Shakespeare Company.
townsfolk.translationZh: 镇上的居民可不这么看，而且地方议会也不直接资助皇家莎士比亚剧团。
townsfolk.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
townsfolk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

townsfolk.sentenceEn: And there are the townsfolk who largely live off the tourists who come, not to see the plays, but to look at Anne Hathaway's Cottage, Shakespeare's birthplace and the other sights.
townsfolk.translationZh: 另一方则是镇上的居民，他们的生计主要依靠游客，但这些游客来此并非为了看戏，而是为了参观安妮·海瑟薇的 cottage（注：可译为“小屋”或保留原文）、莎士比亚的出生地以及其他景点。
townsfolk.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
townsfolk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

townsfolk.sentenceEn: Anyway, the townsfolk can't understand why the Royal Shakespeare Company needs a subsidy.
townsfolk.translationZh: 不管怎样，镇上的居民就是不明白为什么皇家莎士比亚剧团需要补贴。
townsfolk.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
townsfolk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

transaction.sentenceEn: Mr. Schmidt described it as a "voluntary ecosystem" in which "individuals and organizations can complete online transactions with confidence, trusting the identities of each other and the identities of the infrastructure on which the transaction runs."
transaction.translationZh: 施密特先生将其描述为一个“自愿生态系统”，在这个系统中，“个人和组织可以放心地完成在线交易，信任彼此的身份以及交易所依赖的基础设施的身份。”
transaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

transaction.sentenceEn: That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions .
transaction.translationZh: 这项裁决引发了商业方法专利申请的激增，最初是新兴互联网公司试图为特定类型的在线交易争取独家权利。
transaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

transaction.sentenceEn: Conrail's net railway operating income in 1996 was just $427 million, less than half of the carrying costs of the transaction .
transaction.translationZh: 1996年，康雷尔公司的铁路运营净收入仅为4.27亿美元，不足该交易融资成本的一半。
transaction.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
transaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

transaction.sentenceEn: Our banking is done at automated teller terminals that thank us with mechanical politeness for the transaction .
transaction.translationZh: 我们的银行业务通过自动取款终端完成，这些终端会以机械的礼貌对我们的交易表示感谢。
transaction.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
transaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

transaction.sentenceEn: Some companies are limiting the risk by conducting online transactions only with established business partners who are given access to the company's private intranet.
transaction.translationZh: 一些公司为了降低风险，只与那些被允许访问公司专用内部网的固定商业伙伴进行在线交易。
transaction.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
transaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

transaction.sentenceEn: It involves a very big business transaction .
transaction.translationZh: 这涉及一笔非常大的商业交易。

triumph.sentenceEn: By the time that Shakespeare was twenty-five, Lyly, Peele, and Greene had made comedies that were at once popular and literary; Kyd had written a tragedy that crowded the pit; and Marlowe had brought poetry and genius to triumph on the common stage – where they had played no part since the death of Euripides.
triumph.translationZh: 到莎士比亚二十五岁时，利里、皮尔和格林已创作出既通俗又具文学性的喜剧；基德写出了一部让剧场正厅座无虚席的悲剧；而马洛则将诗歌与天才带上了大众舞台并大获成功——自欧里庇得斯去世后，诗歌与天才在这个舞台上便已销声匿迹。
triumph.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

triumph.sentenceEn: In his latest book, Doing Our Own Thing: The Degradation of Language and Music and Why We Should Like, Care, John McWhorter, a linguist and controversialist of mixed liberal and conservative views, sees the triumph of 1960s counter-culture as responsible for the decline of formal English.
triumph.translationZh: 语言学家约翰·麦克沃特（John McWhorter）是一位观点混杂着自由派与保守派色彩的争议性人物，他在最新著作《做自己的事：语言与音乐的退化及我们为何应该在意》中指出，20世纪60年代反主流文化的胜利是导致正式英语衰落的原因。
triumph.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
triumph.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

triumph.sentenceEn: In both oral and written English, talking is triumphing over speaking, spontaneity over craft.
triumph.translationZh: 无论是英语口语还是书面语，随意的闲聊正在取代正式的言说，即兴发挥也正在取代精雕细琢。
triumph.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
triumph.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

triumph.sentenceEn: To paraphrase 18th-century statesman Edmund Burke, "all that is needed for the triumph of a misguided cause is that good people do nothing."
triumph.translationZh: 借用18世纪政治家埃德蒙·伯克的话来说：'一项误入歧途的事业要取得成功，只需要好人袖手旁观。'
triumph.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
triumph.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

triumph.sentenceEn: If the small hot spots look as expected, that will be a triumph for yet another scientific idea, a refinement of the Big Bang called the inflationary universe theory.
triumph.translationZh: 如果这些小型热点与预期相符，那将是另一项科学观点的胜利，即被称为宇宙暴涨理论的大爆炸理论的精细化阐述。
triumph.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
triumph.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

truly.sentenceEn: Yet these objects aren't truly ephemeral, because they're still here, decades, even centuries later.
truly.translationZh: 然而这些物品并非真正短暂易逝，因为数十年甚至数百年后的今天，它们依然存在。
truly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

truly.sentenceEn: If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can sit it earlier should be allowed to do so.
truly.translationZh: 如果律师资格考试对于准律师而言确实是足够严格的测试，那么就应该允许那些能够提前参加考试的人这样做。
truly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

truly.sentenceEn: Sometimes years are required for truly novel discovery claims to be accepted and appreciated.
truly.translationZh: 有时候，真正新颖的发现声明需要数年时间才能被接受和认可。
truly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第9句

truly.sentenceEn: This was all a bit bourgeois for Thomas Carlyle, who focused his biographies on the truly heroic lives of Martin Luther, Oliver Cromwell and Napoleon Bonaparte.
truly.translationZh: 对于托马斯·卡莱尔而言，这一切都显得有些过于资产阶级了，他的传记作品聚焦于马丁·路德、奥利弗·克伦威尔和拿破仑·波拿巴等人物真正具有英雄气概的人生。
truly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

truly.sentenceEn: At the same time, the policy addresses none of the truly thorny questions about homework.
truly.translationZh: 与此同时，该政策并未解决任何与家庭作业相关的真正棘手问题。
truly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

truly.sentenceEn: "The valuable examples which they furnish of the power of self-help, of patient purpose, resolute working, and steadfast integrity, issuing in the formation of truly noble and manly character, exhibit," wrote Smiles, "what it is in the power of each to accomplish for himself."
truly.translationZh: 斯迈尔斯写道：“他们身上所展现的宝贵榜样——自助的力量、坚定的意志、不懈的努力和始终如一的正直品格，最终铸就了真正高尚而有男子气概的人格——展示了每个人都有能力为自己成就一番事业。”
truly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句
